name: domains.unique/mcp-server
title: Unique.domains
description: Ask your assistant for the strongest domain names you can still buy, or to check one. No key.

tools.name: ud_get_name
tools.description: The answer for one domain name: status, drop day, price today, registry facts, word facts and similar sales. Use it first when someone asks if a domain name is taken, available or for sale, what it costs to register and to renew, or wants a name idea checked before buying it. The status `not_checked` means no answer: the name may be taken. Pass `name` (such as get.plumbing).

name.description: A full domain name on an ending in the catalog, such as harbor.io: lowercase, an internationalized name as punycode. A bare word, a subdomain, an email address or an unknown ending is refused with the reason, and a suggestion when there is one.

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level keys to keep: name, ending, tracked, status, lifecycle, drop, ownableNow, price, registry, parking, length, format, shape, word, rating, verdict, value, comps.

tools.name: ud_get_name_registry
tools.description: The registry record of one name: dates, registrar, status codes, nameservers, DNSSEC and holder. Use it when someone asks who holds a name, which registrar it is at, when it was registered or when it expires: the record a WHOIS lookup shows. Pass `name` (such as get.plumbing).

name.description: A full domain name on an ending in the catalog, such as harbor.io: lowercase, an internationalized name as punycode. A bare word, a subdomain, an email address or an unknown ending is refused with the reason, and a suggestion when there is one.

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level keys to keep: read, createdAt, updatedAt, expiresAt, registrar, eppStatuses, nameservers, dnssec, holder.

tools.name: ud_get_name_dns
tools.description: The DNS records of one name, with its parking venue. Use it when someone asks whether a name has a website behind it, points anywhere or is parked, and with which parking service. Pass `name` (such as get.plumbing).

name.description: A full domain name on an ending in the catalog, such as harbor.io: lowercase, an internationalized name as punycode. A bare word, a subdomain, an email address or an unknown ending is refused with the reason, and a suggestion when there is one.

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level keys to keep: read, ns, a, aaaa, cname, mx, hasWebsite, parking.

tools.name: ud_get_name_comps
tools.description: The similar-sales aggregate of one name and how many endings its word sold on. Use it when someone asks what similar names sold for, or wants a price reference before buying or selling a name. It answers a count and a median of similar sales, not a value for the name itself. Pass `name` (such as get.plumbing).

name.description: A full domain name on an ending in the catalog, such as harbor.io: lowercase, an internationalized name as punycode. A bare word, a subdomain, an email address or an unknown ending is refused with the reason, and a suggestion when there is one.

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level keys to keep: tier, count, medianUsd, endingsSoldOn.

tools.name: ud_get_name_auction
tools.description: The open auction of one name, if any: venue, deadline, bid and the first-year cost. Use it when someone asks whether a name is at auction now, its current bid or its deadline. Pass `name` (such as get.plumbing).

name.description: A full domain name on an ending in the catalog, such as harbor.io: lowercase, an internationalized name as punycode. A bare word, a subdomain, an email address or an unknown ending is refused with the reason, and a suggestion when there is one.

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level keys to keep: venue, venueLabel, endsAt, bid, bidCount, currency, firstYear, bidsJumped.

tools.name: ud_resolve_word
tools.description: Turns what a caller typed into the catalog word it names, or up to five candidates. Use it first when a word is misspelled, plural or unclear, to find the catalog word the word tools take. Pass `q` (such as harbors).

q.description: What the caller typed, 1 to 255 characters.

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level keys to keep: match, candidates.

tools.name: ud_list_word_categories
tools.description: The catalog's word categories, by name. Use it when someone wants the word categories to browse or filter by. Its one input, `fields`, is optional.

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level keys to keep: slug, name.

tools.name: ud_get_word_endings
tools.description: A word's endings: counts, the key endings and the open names per ending. Use it when someone is naming a business, product or project and has a word in mind: it shows which endings, such as .com, .io or .ai, are still available or for sale for that word. A word with no count yet answers null; zeros are real. Pass `word` (such as organic); the other inputs are optional.

word.description: The catalog slug or the word.

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level keys to keep: byGroup, keyEndings, openByEnding, cheapest.

tools.name: ud_get_word_notability
tools.description: A word's Wikipedia page and Wikidata entry: title, backlinks, languages and description. Use it when someone asks how widely known a word is as a public topic. Pass `word` (such as harbor).

word.description: The catalog slug or the word.

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level keys to keep: wikipediaTitle, backlinks, languages, wikidataId, description.

tools.name: ud_list_domains
tools.description: One-word catalog names under filters. Use it when someone looks for domain names they can still buy: one-word names that are available or for sale, filtered by ending, length, price or style, not by topic. Neutral order, one page at a time. Every input is optional; `limit` sets the page size.

ending.description: Comma list of endings without the dot.

status.description: Comma list of statuses: available, premium, resell, expiring, expired, taken, dormant, sold, unknown. Default: available, premium, resell.

shape.description: Comma list of word shapes: single, properNoun, acronym, twoWords, phrase. Proper nouns are left out here.

style.description: Comma list of styles: modern, elegant, slab, handwritten, playful, futuristic.

pos.description: Comma list of parts of speech: adjective, adjective satellite, adverb, conjunction, contraction, determiner, interjection, letter, noun, particle, pnoun, pnound, preposition, prepPhrase, pronoun, proverb, symbol, verb, unknown.

expiresBefore.description: Registry expiry on or before this day.

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level keys to keep: name, ending, status, price, priceKind, renewal, ratingBand, format, shape, length, coverage, value, upsidePercent, liquidity, verdict.

tools.name: ud_get_domain_drops
tools.description: The names dropping on one day, counted by ending. Use it when someone asks about expiring or dropping domain names: how many drop on a day, from today to 6 days ahead, and on which endings. Every input is optional; `limit` sets the page size.

day.description: The drop day, UTC; default today.

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level keys to keep: count, byEnding, sample, name, ending, dropsOn, status.

tools.name: ud_list_domain_hacks
tools.description: Domain hacks: names whose ending completes the word. Use it when someone wants a short name in which the ending spells the last letters of the word. Every input is optional; `limit` sets the page size.

ending.description: Comma list of endings without the dot.

status.description: Comma list of statuses: available, premium, resell, expiring, expired, taken, dormant, sold, unknown. Default: available, premium, resell.

shape.description: Comma list of word shapes: single, properNoun, acronym, twoWords, phrase. Proper nouns are left out here.

style.description: Comma list of styles: modern, elegant, slab, handwritten, playful, futuristic.

pos.description: Comma list of parts of speech: adjective, adjective satellite, adverb, conjunction, contraction, determiner, interjection, letter, noun, particle, pnoun, pnound, preposition, prepPhrase, pronoun, proverb, symbol, verb, unknown.

expiresBefore.description: Registry expiry on or before this day.

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level keys to keep: name, ending, status, price, priceKind, renewal, ratingBand, format, shape, length, coverage, value, upsidePercent, liquidity, verdict.

tools.name: ud_get_catalog_stats
tools.description: Catalog headline totals. Use it when someone asks how many names the catalog tracks and how many are open. Its one input, `fields`, is optional.

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level keys to keep: domains, words, tlds.

tools.name: ud_list_tlds
tools.description: Every root TLD with its registry facts and launch phases, alphabetical. Use it when someone wants to browse endings by type, country or status; it answers one page at a time. Every input is optional; `limit` sets the page size.

country.description: The registry operator's country, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2.

publicSet.description: `true`: only the endings with a public page on unique.domains.

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level keys to keep: tld, slug, ianaStatus, kind, ianaType, registryOperator, registryCountryCode, isBrand, isIdn, delegatedOn, removedOn, contractTerminated, rdapServer, category, phases, insights.

tools.name: ud_get_tld
tools.description: One TLD in full: registry facts, phases, market, quality band and registrar prices. Use it when someone weighs one ending, such as .ai or .io, or asks what it costs: who runs it, its launch phases, its market and what registrars charge for it, the first year and to renew. Pass `tld` (such as ai).

tld.description: The ending without the dot (`ai`), ASCII or `xn--` form; lowercased, a leading dot stripped.

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level keys to keep: slug, registry, phases, market, quality, registrars, githubRepoUrl.

tools.name: ud_get_tld_stats
tools.description: The ending's market figures, and with history its daily rows. Use it when someone asks how one ending's market is doing, such as its registrations or sales over time. Pass `tld` (such as ai); the other inputs are optional.

tld.description: The ending without the dot (`ai`), ASCII or `xn--` form; lowercased, a leading dot stripped.

history.description: Days of daily rows, newest first; absent = the latest row only.

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level keys to keep: tld, tracked, available, availableOneWord, resell, expiring90d, registrations90d, medianBuy, medianRenew, cheapestRegistrar, sales12m, salesPrev12m, salesMedian12m, salesTrend, salesMonthly, sales30d, salesMedian30d, salesMedianPrev12m, panel, history.

tools.name: ud_list_tld_phases
tools.description: Every dated launch phase of the ending, chronological. Use it when someone asks when an ending opens, such as its sunrise or general availability dates. Pass `tld` (such as web).

tld.description: The ending without the dot (`ai`), ASCII or `xn--` form; lowercased, a leading dot stripped.

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level keys to keep: phase, startsOn, endsOn, programLabel.

tools.name: ud_list_tld_changes
tools.description: The ending's public registry changes, newest first. Use it when someone asks what changed at an ending's registry lately. Pass `tld` (such as web); the other inputs are optional.

tld.description: The ending without the dot (`ai`), ASCII or `xn--` form; lowercased, a leading dot stripped.

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level keys to keep: kind, after, seenOn.

tools.name: ud_list_tld_keywords
tools.description: The keywords the catalog attaches to the ending, by type. Use it when someone asks which words or topics an ending suits. Pass `tld` (such as ai); the other inputs are optional.

tld.description: The ending without the dot (`ai`), ASCII or `xn--` form; lowercased, a leading dot stripped.

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level keys to keep: type, keyword, power.

tools.name: ud_list_tld_applications
tools.description: ICANN's 2026 new gTLD round, A to Z, with two simple bands. Use it when someone asks who applied for new endings in the 2026 round, or which strings are contested. Every input is optional; `limit` sets the page size.

q.description: The string, its U-label, the applicant, the contention set or the country contains this text.

type.description: The boards' reading of ICANN's type.

status.description: The boards' reading of ICANN's status.

contention.description: In a contention set, or not.

word.description: The string is a word of the catalog's corpus.

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level keys to keep: applicationId, string, uLabel, applicant, applicantCountryCode, type, status, contentionSet, announcedOn, wordPopularityBand, comparableSalesBand, typeKey, statusKey, setSize, applicantCount, inWordCorpus.

tools.name: ud_list_tld_application_changes
tools.description: Every status or contention change of the round, newest first. Use it when someone asks what moved in the 2026 round lately, such as a withdrawal or a contention change. Every input is optional; `limit` sets the page size.

since.description: A day or an ISO 8601 timestamp: changes seen at or after it.

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level keys to keep: applicationId, string, kind, before, after, seenAt.

tools.name: ud_get_tld_application_string
tools.description: One applied-for string: its applications and its change history. Use it when someone asks about one applied-for ending, such as who applied for it. Pass `string` (such as account).

string.description: The applied-for string, lowercased ASCII (an IDN as its A-label).

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level keys to keep: string, applications, changes.

tools.name: ud_list_registrars
tools.description: The nine registrars whose daily price lists are compared, in catalog order. Use it when someone asks which registrars the price comparisons cover. Its one input, `fields`, is optional.

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level keys to keep: slug, name, kind, ianaId, accredited, homepageUrl, siteUrl, logoUrl, endingsPriced.

tools.name: ud_list_registrar_prices
tools.description: A registrar's list prices, alphabetical by ending. Use it when someone asks what one registrar charges for its endings, first year and renewal. Pass `registrar` (such as namecheap); the other inputs are optional.

registrar.description: A registrar catalog slug of the nine, exactly (`name.com`, no `name-com` alias).

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level keys to keep: extension, purchasePrice, renewalPrice, transferPrice, isPromo, currency, delisted.

tools.name: ud_list_registrar_changes
tools.description: A registrar's confirmed list-price changes, newest first. Use it when someone asks how one registrar's prices changed lately. Pass `registrar` (such as namecheap).

registrar.description: A registrar catalog slug of the nine, exactly (`name.com`, no `name-com` alias).

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level keys to keep: extension, registrar, registrarName, field, oldPrice, newPrice, currency, confirmedAt.

tools.name: ud_list_price_changes
tools.description: Confirmed registrar price changes across the nine, newest first. Use it when someone asks which registrar prices changed lately. Every input is optional.

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level keys to keep: extension, registrar, registrarName, field, oldPrice, newPrice, currency, confirmedAt.

tools.name: ud_list_price_traps
tools.description: Endings whose cheapest first year renews at a trap price, alphabetical. Use it when someone asks which endings cost much more to renew than to register, or wants to avoid a cheap first year followed by a costly renewal. Every input is optional.

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level keys to keep: tld, multiple, cheapestYearOne, cheapestRenewalElsewhere.

tools.name: ud_list_venues
tools.description: The parking and marketplace venues with a profile and their rounded footprint. Use it when someone asks which marketplaces or parking services list names, and how many. Its one input, `fields`, is optional.

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level keys to keep: slug, name, kind, ianaId, accredited, homepageUrl, siteUrl, logoUrl, footprint.

tools.name: ud_get_venue
tools.description: One venue's profile with its verified listing terms. Use it when someone asks about one marketplace's or parking service's terms, such as its commission. Pass `id` (such as afternic).

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level keys to keep: slug, name, kind, ianaId, accredited, homepageUrl, siteUrl, logoUrl, footprint, listingTerms.

tools.name: ud_list_iana_registrars
tools.description: The IANA registrar list, by IANA id. Use it when someone asks for accredited registrars beyond the nine compared; it answers one page at a time. Every input is optional; `limit` sets the page size.

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level keys to keep: id, name, status, rdapBaseUrl.

tools.name: ud_get_iana_registrar
tools.description: One IANA registrar by id. Use it when someone holds an IANA registrar number and asks who it is. Pass `id` (such as 1861).

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level keys to keep: id, name, status, rdapBaseUrl.

tools.name: ud_get_market_sales
tools.description: The domain sales pulse as headline aggregates: windows, price bands and the sold-before count. Use it when someone asks how domain names are selling overall: how many sold lately, at what median and in which price bands. Totals, not single sales. Its one input, `fields`, is optional.

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level keys to keep: pulse, soldBefore.

tools.name: ud_list_market_sales_series
tools.description: One sales series by day, week or month, oldest first. Use it when someone wants sales over time, to chart them or compare periods. Pass `kind` (such as week).

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level keys to keep: periodStart, count, meanUsd, medianUsd, comCount, aiCount.

tools.name: ud_list_market_sales_endings
tools.description: Each ending's 12-month and 30-day sales figures, alphabetical. Use it when someone asks which endings sell and for how much, such as what .ai or .io names sell for: a count and a median per ending. Its one input, `fields`, is optional.

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level keys to keep: ending, count12m, median12mUsd, prevCount12m, prevMedian12mUsd, trendWord, count30d, median30dUsd.

tools.name: ud_get_market_sales_lengths
tools.description: Sales by label length for .com, .ai, .io and .co. Use it when someone asks how the length of a name relates to its sale price. Its one input, `fields`, is optional.

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level keys to keep: com, ai, io, co.

tools.name: ud_list_market_sales_movers
tools.description: Up to ten words whose sales moved over the last 30 days. Use it when someone asks which words are selling more or less lately. Its one input, `fields`, is optional.

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level keys to keep: word, sales30d, prev30d, direction, sales90d, median12mUsd, prevMedian12mUsd, endingsSoldOn.

tools.name: ud_get_market_auctions
tools.description: Today's domain auctions by venue, ending and length, the next seven days and the tracked counts. Use it when someone asks how many domain names are at auction or closing today, by venue, ending and length. Totals, not a list of names. Its one input, `fields`, is optional.

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level keys to keep: day, closing, withBid, trackedNames, byVenue, byEnding, byLength, next7Days.

tools.name: ud_list_market_auctions_sample
tools.description: The day's fixed sample of up to 20 single-word names at auction, by deadline. Use it when someone asks what is at auction today or wants auction names to look at. A fixed daily sample of single-word names, not every auction. Its one input, `fields`, is optional.

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level keys to keep: name, ending, venue, venueLabel, endsAt, currency, bid, bidCount, verdict, firstYear, tag.

tools.name: ud_list_market_auction_venues
tools.description: The seven auction venues with their verified rules and today's counts. Use it when someone asks how an auction venue works, or how many auctions it runs today. Its one input, `fields`, is optional.

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level keys to keep: id, label, currency, kinds, closeRule, paymentRule, bidderRule, firstYear, today.

tools.name: ud_list_trends
tools.description: Every published trend with its latest edition figures and its first and last edition day. Use it when someone looks for rising topics to name a project after; it answers one page at a time. Every input is optional; `limit` sets the page size.

category.description: A trend category slug, as the trend categories list names it.

lane.description: How the trend rises: `weekly` for a topic rising now, `yearly` for one rising over the year.

since.description: Trends whose last edition day is on or after this UTC day.

sort.description: `slug`, or `day` for the last edition day, newest first.

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level keys to keep: slug, name, category, definition, volume, growth, lane, headWord, whyNow, firstEditionOn, lastEditionOn, editionCount.

tools.name: ud_get_trend
tools.description: One trend: its latest row, its head words, its figures at every edition and its observations. Use it when someone asks about one trend: how it grew and its key words. Pass `slug` (such as ambient-lights).

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level keys to keep: slug, name, category, definition, volume, growth, lane, headWord, whyNow, firstEditionOn, lastEditionOn, editionCount, headWords, editions, observations.

tools.name: ud_list_trend_categories
tools.description: The trend categories, to narrow the trends by. Use it when someone wants trends from one field only, such as business or health. Its one input, `fields`, is optional.

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level keys to keep: slug, name.

tools.name: ud_list_events
tools.description: The industry events of one month, in date order, then the events still without a date. Use it when someone asks about domain or internet industry events in a month. Every input is optional.

month.description: `YYYY-MM`, from the month of today minus 30 days to today plus 18 months; the current month by default.

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level keys to keep: slug, kind, title, startsOn, endsOn, category, countryCode, city, lat, lng.

tools.name: ud_get_event
tools.description: One industry event with its organizer, location and description. Use it when someone asks for the details of one event. Pass `slug` (such as registrar-day-afnic-2027).

slug.description: The event's slug, at most 160 characters.

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level keys to keep: slug, title, startsOn, endsOn, category, countryCode, city, lat, lng, organizer, location, description.

tools.name: ud_get_agenda
tools.description: The whole public agenda of one month: industry events, TLD launch phases and registry changes. Use it when someone asks what happens in a month: events, ending launches and registry changes. Every input is optional.

month.description: `YYYY-MM`, from the month of today minus 30 days to today plus 18 months; the current month by default.

category.description: An event category, or `launches` for the TLD entries.

tld.description: A bare root ending the catalog knows.

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level keys to keep: entries, recentlyAdded, undated.

tools.name: ud_get_latest_edition
tools.description: The latest daily edition of Business Ideas or Trending Domains: trends with open names, for founders or for investors. Use it when someone wants name ideas for a new business, or names to buy around rising topics; it carries the edition's open names only, and at most 20 trends while `trendCount` counts the whole edition. Pass `persona` (such as founder).

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level keys to keep: persona, date, publishAt, trendCount, nameCount, openCount, previousDate, nextDate, trends.

tools.name: ud_get_edition
tools.description: One dated daily edition of Business Ideas or Trending Domains: founders read the first, investors the second. Use it when someone asks about a past day's edition. Before 2026-11-10 a day may hold the investors' edition only, which founders read too: the answer then says `investor`. Pass `persona` (such as founder) and `date` (such as 2026-11-10).

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level keys to keep: persona, date, publishAt, trendCount, nameCount, openCount, previousDate, nextDate, trends.

tools.name: ud_get_meta_enums
tools.description: Every list of values the answers use, such as statuses, venues and bands. Use it when an answer holds a code and someone needs its meaning. An auction answer names its own venue on each row, which may be one this list leaves out. Its one input, `fields`, is optional.

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level keys to keep: statuses, lifecycles, eppStatuses, lookupStates, wordShapes, wordOrigins, tldKinds, agendaCategories, eventCategories, editionLanes, changeEventTypes, changeEventSubjects, auctionVenues, parkingServices.

tools.name: ud_list_meta_datasets
tools.description: The free GitHub datasets that hold the same rows as these answers. Use it when someone wants the data in bulk, as files. Its one input, `fields`, is optional.

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level keys to keep: id, repository, url, endpoint, updatedOn.

tools.name: ud_list_meta_trademark_classes
tools.description: The 45 Nice classes a trademark is filed under. Use it when a trademark answer names a class number and someone needs what it covers. Its one input, `fields`, is optional.

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level keys to keep: class, title, kind.

tools.name: ud_get_meta_providers
tools.description: Registrar identities and the auction venue and parking service catalogs. Use it when someone needs the registrars, auction venues and parking services an answer may name. An auction answer names its own venue on each row, which may be one this list leaves out. Its one input, `fields`, is optional.

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level keys to keep: registrars, auctionVenues, parkingServices.
